data.exact_reserve_text: Underwriting performance has been supplemented by GBP 3.3m (2014: GBP 1.1m) favourable development.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 per the balance sheet was GBP 90.742m. The managing agent notes a favourable development of GBP 3.3m in the year (2014: GBP 1.1m) which supplemented underwriting performance. A clear gross prior-year movement by underwriting-year (gross PYD) figure was not identifiable in the published notes available in the scanned pages; therefore no single gross PYD amount has been extracted. Narrative indicates prior-year favourable development but the gross movement reconciliation or a gross movement note was not located with certainty.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (2014) on page 18: 90,742 (units GBP 90,742,000 -> 90.742m). A narrative sentence stating 'Underwriting performance has been supplemented by GBP 3.3m (2014: GBP 1.1m) favourable development.' was found and copied verbatim; however an explicit GROSS prior-year movement note ("Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" showing an Insurance liabilities/gross column) was not clearly identifiable in the scanned pages. The claims development table appears in the notes but the scanned resolution prevented reliable numeric extraction for a triangle-based PYD calculation. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null rather than risking an incorrect gross figure. Gross premiums written taken from the Technical Account summary (2015 = GBP 153,646k -> 153.646m) on page 16. gross_premium_mix (segmental breakdown) could not be reliably transcribed from the scanned pages. The claims development triangle is present in the notes (around page 43) but numeric rows could not be reliably parsed from the scans; see _claims_triangle.page. Where confidence is <1.0 this reflects OCR/readability limits of the supplied scans.
